findings.highlight: In this situation, doing so will be fatal
findings.evidenceJa: 増えていく虫より、その行為こそが致命的だ
findings.governingReading: turning his back is more likely to be fatal than the increasing insects
findings.explanation: The comparison explaining why Shirou waits despite the growing swarm disappears.

findings.highlight: I have to make my stand, no matter what
findings.evidenceJa: ギリギリまで、俺はここで持ち堪えるだけだ
findings.governingReading: he need only hold out here until the last possible moment
findings.explanation: A bounded endurance decision becomes an absolute stand regardless of circumstances.

findings.highlight: I tighten my grip on my weapon
findings.evidenceJa: 警策をしっかりと握り直し
findings.governingReading: he firmly readjusts his grip on the keisaku
findings.explanation: The concrete temple stick is generalized to a weapon.

findings.governingReading: the darkness formed by the insects
findings.explanation: mirror moon again narrows generic insects to worms.

findings.governingReading: he glares at the insect-user who should remain before him
findings.explanation: The role identifying Zouken through his control of the swarm is omitted.

findings.highlight: I hear wind blowing far off
findings.evidenceJa: 遠くで風鳴りが聞こえた
findings.governingReading: he hears a distant wind-roar or wind sound
findings.explanation: A discrete, ominous sound is normalized into ordinary wind blowing.

findings.highlight: murderous intent that is almost visible
findings.evidenceJa: 気配[line3]目に見えるほどの殺気
findings.governingReading: a presence—murderous intent so strong it seems visible
findings.explanation: The broken transition from sensed presence to visible-seeming killing intent disappears.
Zouken’s identity as controller of the insects is again omitted.
The existential disappearance Zouken claims is rendered as game-like elimination.
A cognitive arrest is literalized as the brain itself stopping.

findings.highlight: Can you not tell that simple fact?
findings.evidenceJa: そんな事も判らぬのか小僧
findings.governingReading: can you not understand even that, boy
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts “simple fact,” sharpening Zouken’s taunt with an unsupported epistemic judgment.

findings.evidenceJa: 今にも消えそうに、段々と薄れていっているが
findings.governingReading: it is gradually fading as though it may disappear at any moment
findings.explanation: The pace and imminent threshold supporting Shirou’s desperate inference disappear.

findings.highlight: was about to activate, but suddenly stopped
findings.evidenceJa: 確かに起動しようとしたのに止まってしまった
findings.governingReading: certainly began trying to activate, then stopped
findings.explanation: An activation response that actually commenced becomes a merely imminent event; “suddenly” is added.

findings.evidenceJa: 令呪に応えるべきセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber, who ought to answer the Command Spell
findings.explanation: The causal inference that Saber is the party expected to answer the functioning spell is reduced to a vague endpoint problem.
Zouken’s taunt about Shirou’s bad fortune becomes a direct intelligence insult.

findings.highlight: has been killed by my Servant
findings.evidenceJa: とうに、我がサーヴァントによって死に絶えた
findings.governingReading: has long since perished completely at his Servant’s hands
findings.explanation: The claimed prior completion and annihilating force of Zouken’s statement are weakened.
Shirou’s interrupted accusation that Zouken is talking delirious nonsense becomes an awkward profanity.
